intro: A notice lists two items stolen: a Dark Iron tuyere and a Lookout's Spyglass. The Thorium Brotherhood is certain unscrupulous, jealous Dark Iron dwarves of the Searing Gorge took them, and whoever finds them is to take them to Taskmaster Scrange for payment.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The following items have been stolen:
A reward is being offered to individuals who find and return these pilfered items.
The Thorium Brotherhood is certain that these items were stolen by unscrupulous and jealous Dark Iron dwarves that inhabit the Searing Gorge.
The spyglass in question was an excellent tool for the lookouts and the tuyere was an irreplaceable smithing tool.
Should you find the missing items, return them to Scrange.

clips.title: Progress
paras: If you're here for the reward, you're gonna have to give me the stolen goods.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Fantastic work! Now for your reward.
